faqs.question: What does “verified” actually mean on a listing?
faqs.answer: A surveyor and a lawyer from our team visit in person, take timestamped photography, and check the RAJUK approved plan, mutation porcha, khatiyan and non-encumbrance certificate. If any link in the chain is doubtful, the listing is rejected.

faqs.question: Is the listed price the real price?
faqs.answer: Yes. It reflects the agreement with the verified owner, and it is the number you negotiate down from. We hand you an exact closing-cost statement upfront — stamp duty, registration tax, gain tax and our fee — with nothing added later.

faqs.question: I live abroad. Can I buy without flying back?
faqs.answer: Yes. We run live walkthroughs in your timezone, prepare the consular power of attorney for your nearest mission, and complete registration at the sub-registry office. Most purchases close in six to ten weeks without the buyer landing.

faqs.question: How do you track construction progress?
faqs.answer: Our engineers inspect active sites every thirty days. The progress meter reflects audited milestones — piling, frame, MEP, interior — backed by dated site photography, not a developer brochure.

faqs.question: Can landowners partner on a joint venture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the land details and we come back with a feasibility report, the owner share, bank-backed signing security and a delivery date written into the contract.

faqs.question: Do you arrange home loans?
faqs.answer: We take your file to the banks currently offering the best rate for your profile and push pre-approval through in about seventy-two hours. We take nothing from the bank for it, so the recommendation is not bought.

story.quote: After counting my peers, I found that they had a record of handing over on time. That is what convinced me to give them my land.
story.quoteName: Air Vice Marshal A. O. Mahmud (Retd.)
story.whyTitle: Why choose us as a partner for your land?
story.whyBody: Dealing with a developer in Dhaka is hard to judge from the outside — the joint venture process is bureaucratic, and the promises all sound alike. We put the terms in the deed instead of the brochure: the owner share, the signing advance held in bank escrow, and a handover date you can enforce. Read what our landowners say, then look at what we finished.
story.differentBody: We took the legal work in-house rather than subcontracting it, so the title search that decides whether a joint venture is safe is done by people who answer to you. Our engineers inspect every active site each month, and the completion figure you see is the one they signed off. If a timeline is slipping we tell you before you hear it from a neighbour.
story.videoCaption: A landowner walks through a finished joint venture
story.moreBody: Send us the plot address and the deed. Within two weeks you get a feasibility report — what can legally be built there, how many units, and the share we can offer, in writing. No obligation, and the papers stay yours.
